theme: 3 terms on keeping the app responsive: the thread for the screen, the lines of work, and the priority of each task

terms.definition: The thread that draws your screen and handles touches, so it must stay free.
terms.example: Never block the Main Thread with a network call.

terms.definition: A line of tasks that the system runs for you on threads it manages.
terms.example: Send the image resize to a background Dispatch Queue.

terms.definition: A level that tells the system how important and urgent a task is.
terms.example: Use a low Quality of Service for the background cleanup.

quizzes.question: What tells the system how urgent a task is, like user-initiated or utility?

video.title: Main Thread, Dispatch Queue & Quality of Service | Day 102
video.description:
Learn to explain why heavy work freezes the screen and how to fix it: Main Thread, Dispatch Queue & Quality of Service, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Main Thread - The thread that draws your screen and handles touches, so it must stay free.
Dispatch Queue - A line of tasks that the system runs for you on threads it manages.
Quality of Service - A level that tells the system how important and urgent a task is.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 102 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

landscape.title: iOS Main Thread, Dispatch Queue & Quality of Service | Day 102
landscape.description:
Explain Main Thread, Dispatch Queue & Quality of Service in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
메인 스레드, 디스패치 큐, 서비스 품질 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Main Thread - The thread that draws your screen and handles touches, so it must stay free.
한국어: 메인 스레드: 화면을 그리고 터치를 처리하는 스레드로, 항상 비어 있어야 해요

Dispatch Queue - A line of tasks that the system runs for you on threads it manages.
한국어: 디스패치 큐: 시스템이 관리하는 스레드에서 작업을 대신 실행해 주는 작업 대기열

Quality of Service - A level that tells the system how important and urgent a task is.
한국어: 서비스 품질(QoS): 작업이 얼마나 중요하고 급한지 시스템에 알려 주는 단계

In this video, Mina and Jake fix a photo download that freezes the app, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: The app freezes while it downloads. Can you explain why in English?

dialogue.title: The app freezes on download

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the app freezes when I download the photo.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Are you downloading on the Main Thread?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think so. I call `download` directly.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That blocks the Main Thread, so the screen can't update. Use a Dispatch Queue.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Which Dispatch Queue should I use?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A global one, with a Quality of Service. User-initiated fits a button tap.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Update it back on the Main Thread, with the main queue.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. For a background sync, use a lower Quality of Service, like utility.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Got it. Work in the background, screen on the Main Thread.
